skill.name: sendgrid-automation
skill.description: Automate SendGrid email operations through Rube MCP, including campaigns, contacts, sender identities, templates, suppressions, and analytics.
skill.summary: Automates SendGrid campaigns, contacts, sender setup, suppressions, templates, and analytics through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static external command findings are false positives because the evidence is Markdown inline code naming Rube and SendGrid tools, not shell execution. One static network finding is confirmed because the skill directs users to configure a third-party MCP endpoint. Semantic review found sensitive email sending, contact modification, activity export, and third-party broker risks that need explicit authorization controls.

remediation.suggestion: Document what data flows through Rube and Composio, and require consent before connecting SendGrid or following authentication links.
Require explicit approval before campaign sends, all-contact targeting, sender changes, scheduling, or any workflow that reaches recipients.
Preview affected contacts and require confirmation before bulk imports, removals, list deletion, or deleting contacts with lists.
Warn users before CSV exports, confirm the business purpose, and redact recipient-level data when it is not required.

content.value_statement: Email teams need accurate SendGrid workflows without guessing tool schemas. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP operations for campaigns, contacts, senders, and analytics.
actual_capabilities: Search current Rube MCP SendGrid tool schemas before running workflows.
Create marketing lists, add contacts, and verify contact counts after asynchronous updates.
Create Single Send campaigns with sender, recipient, content, and unsubscribe settings.
List, create, update, and verify SendGrid sender identities and authenticated domains.
Review delivery statistics, message activity, categories, suppressions, and CSV exports.
Resolve SendGrid names to required IDs for lists, contacts, senders, and templates.
limitations: Requires a connected Rube MCP server and an active SendGrid connection.
Does not bypass SendGrid verification, suppression, rate limit, or permission controls.
Some activity features require paid SendGrid history add-ons.
Contact imports and updates are asynchronous and may need later verification.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Marketing Campaign
use_cases.description: Create or select lists, choose a verified sender, prepare campaign content, and include required unsubscribe settings.

use_cases.title: Maintain Contact Lists
use_cases.description: Add contacts, update list membership, verify counts, and avoid legacy endpoint confusion during routine list maintenance.

use_cases.title: Review Delivery Performance
use_cases.description: Retrieve statistics, filter message activity, inspect categories, and export activity when account permissions allow it.

prompt_templates.title: Find SendGrid Lists
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the current Rube SendGrid tools, then list my marketing contact lists with IDs and contact counts where available.

prompt_templates.title: Add Contacts Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Search tool schemas, add these approved contacts to the named list, then wait and verify the updated count.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Campaign Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Search SendGrid tool schemas, find the verified sender and target list, then create a Single Send draft with unsubscribe settings.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Recent Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Search current schemas, retrieve delivery statistics for the last 30 days, filter failed messages, and summarize bounce patterns.

output_examples.input: Create a draft campaign for the July newsletter using the Customers list.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the Customers list, confirms a verified sender, prepares campaign content fields, and notes the required unsubscribe setting.

output_examples.input: Add these contacts to the webinar follow-up list and confirm the count.
output_examples.output: The assistant searches the current schema, submits the contact update, waits for processing, and reports the verified list count.

output_examples.input: Show email performance for last week and check failed deliveries.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves weekly statistics, filters message activity, and summarizes delivery, bounce, block, open, and click trends.

best_practices: Search current Rube tool schemas before every workflow because SendGrid parameters may change.
Confirm verified senders, unsubscribe settings, and target lists before creating or sending campaigns.
Preview destructive contact or list changes and require explicit user approval before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not send to all contacts without clear user approval and compliance checks.
Do not mix legacy Contact Database IDs with Marketing API list IDs.
Do not export message activity CSV files without confirming purpose and destination.

faq.question: Does this skill require a SendGrid API key?
faq.answer: It requires an active SendGrid connection through Rube MCP. Authentication is handled through the connected MCP workflow.

faq.question: Can it send marketing campaigns?
faq.answer: It guides Single Send campaign creation and recipient targeting. Actual sending still depends on SendGrid permissions and user approval.

faq.question: Can it manage contacts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide list creation, contact updates, contact lookups, list counts, imports, removals, and delete workflows.

faq.question: Does it support sender identity setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers sender identity listing, creation, updates, verification requests, and domain authentication workflows.

faq.question: Can it export analytics?
faq.answer: Yes, when the SendGrid account supports the required activity history and CSV export features.

faq.question: What approvals are important?
faq.answer: Require approval before campaign sends, all-contact targeting, bulk imports, CSV exports, sender changes, and list deletion.
